Submission Description: (doc-less) Motion to Intervene of Consumers Energy Company under ER27-25-000.

Submission Date:        10/23/2026 9:47:32 AM

Filed Date:             10/23/2026 9:47:32 AM

Dockets
-------
ER27-25-000          Midcontinent Independent System Operator, Inc. submits tariff filing per 35.13(a)(2)(iii): 2026-10-02_Large Load Addition Resource Study (LARS) submitted on 10/2/2026 12:03:09 PM, Filing Type code: 10

Filing Party/Contacts:

Filing Party                             Signer (Representative)                  Other Contact (Principal)               
------------                             -----------------------                  -------------------------               
Consumers Energy Company                 rachael.moore@cmsenergy.com              fercfilings@cmsenergy.com               

Basis for Intervening:
Consumers Energy Company (“Consumers Energy”) is a public utility serving over 1.9 million residential, commercial, and industrial customers in the Lower Peninsula of the State of Michigan.  Consumers Energy is a Load Serving Entity ("LSE") in the Michigan Joint Zone of the Midcontinent Independent System Operator, Inc. (“MISO”) footprint and is actively engaged in the Generator Interconnection Process for large loads. As a result, Consumers Energy has a direct and substantial interest in the outcome of this proceeding, and intervention is appropriate under the Commission’s rules. under its Open Access Transmission, Energy and Operating Reserve Markets Tariff (“Tariff”).  Accordingly, Consumers Energy has a direct and substantial interest in the changes to the MISO Tariff proposed in the above captioned docket, and its interest would not be adequately represented by any other party.  Hence, Consumers Energy’s participation is necessary, in the public interest and appropriate to the administration of the Federal Power Act.
